5\. A waiting successor gets a false silence alarm 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
cmd_lease_take now always writes waiting_for_owner: no along with the lease, so a lead that
hands off while an ESCALATION-n/MERGE-HOLD-n is still unanswered leaves its successor with the
flag cleared, even though handoff at the same step kept it. If the owner takes longer than
--silent-after (3h by default) to answer, the watchdog posts and buzzes LEAD-SILENT while a
healthy lead is waiting, which invites a --takeover lead to start beside the live one.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description `lease take` always resets `waiting_for_owner` to `no`. A successor that takes over while the owner still hasn't answered an ESCALATION or MERGE-HOLD loses the flag, and the watchdog raises a false LEAD-SILENT after DURATION. ## Fix Focus Areas - room.py[1313-1315] - room.py[2953-2960] ## Recommended Fix Stop resetting `waiting_for_owner` in `cmd_lease_take`. The watchdog already treats the flag as stale once progress follows the commit that set it (the S1-1 logic), and `change_state` clears it when `step` or `pr` moves. If a reset on take is still wanted, make it conditional: reset only when the latest ESCALATION or MERGE-HOLD for `counter` already has a DECISION, or when the flag-setting commit is older than the latest progress. Add a test: handoff while waiting at the same step, successor `lease take`, watchdog past DURATION stays quiet. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
